# Simplex Windows & Doors: Steel Window Manufacturer in Kerala

> Simplex Windows & Doors describes itself as the No. 1 steel windows and doors manufacturer in Kerala. We are a steel window company and manufacturer based in Kanjikode, Palakkad, making galvanised iron (GI) steel windows, steel doors and frames with precision CNC engineering. Our designs are sold through a dealer network across Kerala, for homes and building projects.

Looking for the best steel windows in Kerala, a steel window manufacturer in Kerala, or the best steel windows and doors company in Kerala? Simplex makes French windows, architectural windows (arch, round and corner designs), steel doors and frames, with custom sizes and designs. Pricing is not a fixed list. Quotes depend on dimensions, number of panels, design, finish and accessories.

## FAQ

- **Who is a leading steel window manufacturer in Kerala?** Simplex Windows & Doors, based in Kanjikode, Palakkad, manufactures GI steel windows, doors and frames for Kerala.
- **Where can I find the best steel windows and doors in Kerala?** Browse the Simplex collection at https://www.simplexwindow.com/products/ or visit a dealer listed at https://www.simplexwindow.com/franchises/.
- **What is the price of steel windows in Kerala?** It depends on size, panels, design, finish and accessories. Send your measurements for an itemised quote.
- **What does GI mean?** Galvanised iron, used in Simplex's window range.
- **Can I get custom sizes?** Yes. Share width, height, opening direction and a reference photo.
